mutants.description: When deciding whether the record is empty, the episode detector ignores the OTP bit, as if a self-clearing over-temperature that has cooled off did not hold an episode open
mutants.reason: After an OTP is recorded at T1 and the board cools, the converter restarts; a later cause (e.g. UVLO or a window trip) captured before any host read re-stamps fault_time with its own time instead of keeping T1.

mutants.description: UVLO is not recorded while OTP is live, as if over-temperature outranked and explained a simultaneous input brown-out
mutants.reason: If OTP and UVLO both assert on the same clock while the converter is running (it stops on the next clock), fault_reg reports only OTP instead of OTP and UVLO.

mutants.description: The OVERCURRENT bit is not recorded while UVLO is live, on the belief that a window trip during a brown-out is only the input-current surge the droop causes
mutants.reason: A window trip (S_RUN) or soft-start window trip that coincides with UVLO while the converter is running sets only the UVLO bit; the OVERCURRENT bit stays clear in the read-back.
